model.description: Fast multilingual speech in 43 languages with 27 built-in voices or a voice cloned from a short recording, with emotions and delivery set by voice-design presets or by cues in the text such as [happy] or [whisper], plus multi-speaker dialogues line by line. Small (1.8 GB) and far faster than real time; the cues are a fixed set of styles, not free descriptions or sounds.
